para.verbatim: embed:rst Creates the :cpp:class:`ModType` for YelanTranquil -- the skin, a character of THREE components. What a ``.ini`` file built on the skin classifies as. What a Yelan mod is remapped ONTO is her three component ids (:cpp:enumerator:`ModTypeId::YelanTranquilBody` and siblings), which -- like the boss ids -- are targets only and have no factory here: a registered mod type with no keyword has no way to be classified, and the classifier population is not built to hold one

embed:rst Every :cpp:class:`ModType` this builder knows how to make, freshly built on each call :raw-html:`
` :raw-html:`
` The counterpart to the pure-Python ``ModTypes.getAll()`` (``constants/ModTypes.py``). Note this is *not* the same set as :cpp:enum:`ModTypeId`'s members: the two boss ids (``RaidenBoss``, ``ArlecchinoBoss``) are only ever remap targets and have no factory :raw-html:`
